title.narrative: Provincial Water Supply and Sanitation Project

description.narrative: The project will expand and improve urban water supply and sanitation (WSS) services in four of Cambodia’s largest provincial cities, which are important commercial, industrial, and tourist centers but lack access to piped WSS services. The project will also improve institutional capacity to provide sustainable WSS services.

title.narrative: 04 May 2018 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-afd-sign-cofinancing-agreement-provincial-water-supply-and-sanitation-project-cambodia
08 Dec 2017 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-help-improve-water-supply-sanitation-4-cities-cambodia
Loan 3630: 96% of contracts awarded and 68% disbursed as of 23 Jun 2025
Loan 8335: 98% of contracts awarded and 65% disbursed as of 23 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: As of 31 March 2025, overall progress was estimated around 82% against elapsed time of 90%. The revised loan closing date is 31 December 2025. Progress for Output 1 (water supply component) was 28.7%, Output 2 (sanitation component) 35.6%, the rest 18.7%. Four major civil works contracts were awarded. One contract (Siem Reap Trunk Sewer subproject) was completed and three other contracts (Battambang wastewater subproject, Battambang water supply subproject and Kampong Cham water supply subproject) are ongoing. The project is now likely to archive the intended outcomes.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48158/48158-002-apfs-en_8.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48158/48158-002-iee-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | May 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48158/48158-002-sddr-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48158/48158-002-smr-en_16.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Construction activities for water supply pipeline networks including integration with the existing network are ongoing.
Construction of water supply connections by provincial water works are ongoing.
Contracts for Battambang WS (MISTI-CW1-lot1 and MISTI-CW1-lot 2) and Kampong Cham WS (MISTI-CW2) awarded on 18 July 2022 and 29 August 2022, respectively. Construction activities for both water treatment plants are ongoing with progress of 65% and 88%, respectively.
The Battambang WWTP contract was award on 31 December 2020 and construction activities for WWTP are ongoing.
Construction activities for sewer system are ongoing. Due to slow implementation particularly the pipe jacking and household connections, this civil works contract was extended until 30 September 2025.
construction activities of at least 4,200 wastewater connections are ongoing in Battambang wastewater contract. In Siem Reap, 196 connections inclusive of 20 connections under MPWT-CW1 have been installed to date.
Ongoing.
Completed. Master program running, being managed by AFD. 110 students of which 43% are female.
Ongoing. Currently, out of 11 PMU MPWT positions, 3 (27%) are occupied by women. Three women (27%) are financial officer and project management officers. Therefore, only 02 women (18%) who are the project management officers entitled as management position.
Ongoing. Currently, out of 14 PIU DPWT members in Battambang and Siem Reap, 4 (28%) are filled by women and 1 (7%) is in management or supervisory position which is the PIU manager.
Ongoing. 146 officials (47 female or 32%) trained by the project.
Ongoing. Currently, 19.29% for MISTI-CW01-Battambang water supply contract; 16% for MISTI-CW02-Kampong Cham water supply contract; 16.15% for Siem Reap trunk sewer replacement contract, 17.07% for Battambang wastewater subproject.
Ongoing. Currently, out of 13 PMU MISTI positions, 4 (30.76%) are occupied by women. Two women (15%) are accountant and gender officer; two women appointed in management and supervision positions as the chief of procurement officer and chief of technical unit.
Ongoing. Out of 10 PIU PDISTI members in Battambang and Kampong Cham, there are four (04) women or 40% appointed in PIU PDISTI and in management or two (02) women or 20% are assigned to supervisory position (chief of social and environment officer).
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/48158-002/main#project-tenders
